title: Page layouts
description: How pages could be arranged as the site grows.

paragraphs: There are three reading layouts: the case study with its sidebar outline, the single-column write-up, and the three-column documentation template. Listings are one image grid in three variants. These proposals are about what happens between and around those.

sections.title: A write-up with a contents rail

paragraphs: You are looking at this one. A write-up has no navigation beyond the Index link, which suits a short piece and fails a long one. The docs template already has the right component: On this page, with a marker that tracks the section in view.

I borrowed it into the write-up’s gutter. It appears at 70em, where the 37.5em column, a 3rem gap, the 12rem rail and a margin fit on both sides, and it is absent below that. It is opt-in per page: WriteupLayout takes a list of anchors and renders nothing when the list is empty, so existing write-ups are unchanged.
The schematic shows when each rail fits, using the shipped widths. A wider media column makes sense for a case study. I am not convinced both rails belong on one page, so that remains open.
Drag the viewport width and switch the page type.
Digital and Play list everything as image cards. That is right for objects. Write-ups are titles and dates, and a grid of covers hides both: you cannot see what is new, or scan for a subject.

A list view gives each entry one line: title, kind, date in tabular figures. The cover is not thrown away. It rides beside the row you point at and the other rows step back. On touch there is no hover, so the list is just a list, which is the fastest thing to read on a phone anyway.
I would make this a variant of the project grid and let each listing page choose. It also gives #201’s generated title cards a second use as the preview.
Move across the rows, then switch to Grid.
The deep-dive block lets an author fold one passage. This is the same idea applied to the whole page by the reader.

In Skim, every section keeps its title and its first sentence, supporting paragraphs fold away, and each run of media becomes a single row of thumbnails. The page is the same document in the same order, and it is about a third as long. The rail beside the prototype is the page at scale, so you can watch the length change.
It needs one thing from authors: that the first paragraph of a section can stand alone. That is a good discipline regardless.
Scroll the page, then switch to Skim.

Styles as documentation. /styles is one long page with its own sidebar. The docs template would give each component its own page, a contents rail and previous and next links, and the meta page about the editor could live in the same collection.

Derive the sidebar threshold. #98. The schematic’s arithmetic is what a per-page threshold would compute: column, plus two gaps, plus two rails. Container queries on the wrapper could replace the six literals that have to be kept in step by hand.
Breakpoint preview in Edit. #108. The same scaled viewport as the schematic, with the real page inside it.

The contents rail is built and is in this pull request. The readable index deserves a focused motion pass once its place in the site is decided. Skim is worth prototyping on one real long write-up, with a clear choice between reading and skimming, and could become a useful social post.
